changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: Move pioneers away from the initial patrol sweep and bring Hibiscus forward to 25 seconds.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.rejected: Affordable deployments establish a survivable opening.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: Replace Friston-3 at 43 seconds; treat CONFESS-47 survival until its replacement as an explicit unresolved dependency.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.rejected: Late replacement of fragile robots repairs an already collapsed lane.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: Remove Gallus; place Steward within Hibiscus coverage and use Lava's larger HP buffer under Ansel's skill.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.rejected: A single cheap caster can absorb patrol fire.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: Contain officers at column 5 and require eventual clearance of civilian-blocking roadblocks.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.rejected: The civilian routes need observation alone.

corridor_responsibilities.attack: Blocker plus Lava; Midnight's supported skill conversion supplies additional Arts damage.
Steward and Lava during covered patrol passes.
corridor_responsibilities.constraint: No guaranteed lethal damage budget; patrol clearance remains a decisive verification requirement.
Never assign ordinary attacks, blocking or medicinal healing to civilians.
corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Keep nearby officers contained, permit neutral passage, and verify roadblocks cease holding civilians before completion.

explicit_deadline_basis.opening: At column 5, straight waypoint travel places the first central runners near 13.35/18.35 seconds and outer runners near 28.35/33.35 seconds. These are model estimates.

explicit_deadline_basis.economy: Uses natural DP, Fang's cost reduction and automatic income, and Vanilla's stated immediate skill income. No refunds or unsupported robot income.

formation_structure.devices: Remain occupied forbidden tiles. Existing attack ranges may damage ordinary-targetable roadblocks; no manual target-selection command or navigation effect is assumed.
formation_structure.final_ground: Cardigan outer upper; Melantha central upper; Midnight central lower; Beagle outer lower.
formation_structure.lower: Ansel [5,3] RIGHT covers both column-5 lower holds and Lava [5,5].
formation_structure.patrol: Steward attacks upper-right passes; Lava attacks lower-right passes. Neither ground blocking nor unsupported target priority is credited.
formation_structure.upper: Hibiscus [2,5] RIGHT covers both column-5 upper holds and Steward [2,7].

formation_transitions.handoff: Friston-3 to Beagle at [6,5], before the approaching patrol can undermine lower support.
Retreat Lancet-2 before the right-side patrol reaches its position; Ansel takes lower healing at 54 seconds after the patrol has passed the left-side deployment area.
CONFESS-47 to Cardigan at [1,5]. Survival until this handoff is not established.
Fang to Melantha at [3,5], ending upper pioneer dependence.
Vanilla to Midnight at [4,5], after Vanilla's 115-second income activation.

formation_transitions.constraint: Replacement deployment follows retreat by one frame. Do not execute an occupied-lane handoff while another enemy could pass during reacquisition; a failed safe handoff invalidates the candidate.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.rule: At most eight deployed operators; retreat each predecessor before replacement.
Never deploy on the four forbidden roadblock tiles.
Do not credit unsupported robot talents, Cardigan healing, probabilistic talents, splash coverage, refunds or target overrides.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians; officers within 1.2 may attack them.
Do not deliberately release a ground route to pursue the flyer.
A dead blocker or missed income invalidates subsequent fixed affordability assumptions; do not continue reporting the ledger as valid.
Final spawn at 211 seconds is not a completion deadline.
WIN requires positive remaining life, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Establish four column-5 holds, use opening DP skills, heal the upper runner engagement and replace the lower robot. No early caster is exposed to the left patrol.
Complete the lower healing handoff and establish upper patrol fire. Monitor temporary upper-blocker HP and the lower healing gap.
Use Ansel's skill for Lava's patrol exposure, complete final ground upgrades and preserve outer capacity against paired officers.
Use Midnight's Arts skill for the first armored pair; Steward supports the upper armor engagement.
Maintain all four holds through outer officers and central runner pairs; reserve the next Midnight skill for final armored pressure.
Continue attacks, healing and ready defensive skills until hostile clearance and civilian resolution satisfy the complete WIN predicate.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Protect the opening from the patrol's initial left-side sweep by moving all ground holds to column 5. Establish healing before upgrades, then replace economic pioneers with stronger central attackers while keeping all four lanes staffed.

unknown_dependencies.dependency: CONFESS-47 surviving shared upper healing until 96 seconds; this is a major unresolved weakness.
Lower pioneer survival during the 46-54-second healing handoff.
Steward and Lava surviving patrol targeting and dealing 13000 cumulative patrol damage before its exit.
Caster competition between ground enemies, roadblocks and patrol without target-order control.
Civilian release from roadblocks and protection from officers during that delay.
Safe blocker reacquisition and sufficient central clearance between Midnight skill windows.

revised_stage_understanding.CURRENT_MODEL: Deployment economy, waypoint timing, range rotation and combat calculations.
revised_stage_understanding.GameData: Four ground approaches, a flying patrol, two neutral civilian routes and four occupied roadblock tiles.
revised_stage_understanding.UNKNOWN: Client target priority, ordinary WALK navigation around devices, opening survival and sufficient patrol damage.
revised_stage_understanding.changed_interpretation: Civilian passage requires officer containment and eventual roadblock clearance; ordinary operators cannot attack, block or directly heal civilians.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.limitation: This is a tactical candidate, not a demonstrated zero-leak solution. Temporary-blocker survival and the patrol damage budget remain unresolved.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.thesis: Move initial interception to column 5, fund earlier healing, replace temporary outer blockers before sustained pressure, and distribute Arts coverage across the patrol's right-side passes.

revised_tactical_requirements.configuration: Supplied debug configurations; unsupported talents and skills receive no credit.
revised_tactical_requirements.legal_catalog: Only supplied normal_low_star_catalog entries with rarity 1-3 and normal_mode=true; no mode-specific reserves.
